title: Countywide rules for managing county grants
summary: Bill 73 requires countywide administrative rules for the County Grants Program, as county grant funds grew from $44.1 million in FY21 to $123 million in FY26. Draft rules cover fiscal sponsors, insurance, record keeping, payouts and monitoring. A public meeting on them was set for October 7, and the rules will not apply to agreements already in place.
